outcome: Type of peripartum hysterectomy (elective vs. nonelective)
Need for reoperation after peripartum hysterectomy
cohort: Women who underwent delivery of a newborn and had a peripartum hysterectomy during the same admission between 2008 and 2018 at a tertiary care center
finding: White women were more likely to undergo elective peripartum hysterectomy for abnormal placentation, while Black women were more likely to undergo nonelective peripartum hysterectomy for postpartum hemorrhage.
